caption: The drawing displays a rectangular composition featuring a collection of colorful national flags, each labeled with the respective country’s name, under the heading "FLAGS OF THE NATIONS WHICH PARTICIPATE IN THE CENTENNIAL EXHIBITION OF THE UNITED STATES IN 1876." The flags, mainly in hues of red, blue, and white with some yellows and blacks, are arranged in rows and columns, filling most of the space within a thin blue border. The flags represent countries such as the United States, Brazil, Belgium, Great Britain, Japan, Hayti (Haiti), France, Persia, Tunis, Venezuela, Nicaragua, Mexico, Guatemala, U. S. of Columbia, Sandwich Isles, Egypt, Austria, Denmark, Portugal, Bolivia, Chile, Liberia, Ecuador, Switzerland, Argentine Republic, Sweden, Turkey, Germany, Netherlands, Russia, Norway, Siam, Spain, and Italy. At the center of the arrangement, there is an illustrated American bald eagle with spread wings, perched on a shield with stars and stripes, bearing a blue banner inscribed with "E Pluribus Unum." The background is mostly off-white, and the text is written in black capital letters at the top and bottom edges of the drawing.
title: Centennial Textile - Flag
